name: Ashamez's Thunder: Ammo Feed
desc: Blueprint for a firearm accessory that can be used to create said inscribed weapon accessory by consuming materials in the Eye of Graeae's HUD.

value.text:
Increases initial ammo by 20. In the
Lightsear mode, after firing Chain Lightning 12 times, the next 3 Chain Lightning shots will be converted to the more powerful
Gathered Storm, dealing 10% ATK as
Electro DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG, and 3% ATK as
Electro DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction upon bouncing to a target.
Unlocked from Edge of Survival challenges
